text:
zoe: Postmortem follow-up: creating a short closure tracker for streaming/chat fixes (timeouts, partials, reconnect behavior). Keeping owners and done-criteria lightweight. :memo:

kai: Thanks — I'll own reconnect/backoff + SDK defaults. Goal: deploy server + SDK changes to staging and have PR benchmark gating. ETA PR 2027-06-02.

manu: I'll own partial-detection + protocol close codes. Plan: detect truncated frames, emit metric streaming.partial_count, and use close code 435 = truncated_output. ETA PR 2027-06-07. Will add e2e injection tests.

zoe: Observability owner? We need prefix traces, ttfb histograms, and sampled payloads (redact tokens). Proposed retention 7d.

manu: I can add the partial metric and protocol docs. Prefer 7d for samples. Need security signoff.

kai: For reconnect strategy: default cap 1/min per session, exponential backoff with jitter, max_retries 5, and a reconnect_hint header. I'll include a small SDK patch to avoid 2s retry storms. Also adding PR-gate: median TTFB regression <=8%.

security: Noted. 7d retention ok with automated PII redaction. Send redaction regex in the PR for expedited review.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: "chat-stability-spotcheck" for staging 2027-06-10 02:00 UTC for 48h. Includes reconnect flood + cold-start scenarios. Reports -> #eng-sre.

zoe: Acceptance criteria summary: 1) Partial rate <= 0.5% in 24h synthetic canary, 2) median TTFB regression <8% on PR gates, 3) sampled payloads stored 7d with redaction, 4) runbook updated with triage steps.

manu: Runbook items I'll add: how to query streaming.partial_count, sample commands to fetch last session payloads, and remediation steps: warm-restart session, scale warm pool if >X partials.

kai: I'll add resumable tokens and a small PR-benchmark job that fails on TTFB regressions. Example config snippet I'll include in PR: ```yaml
reconnect:
  enabled: true
  max_retries: 5
  base_ms: 300
  max_ms: 45000
  jitter: 0.4
  sdk_rate_limit_per_min: 1
```

zoe: Timeline recap: kai PR 2027-06-02, manu PR 2027-06-07, observability + security signoff by 2027-06-04, canary 2027-06-10 to 2027-06-12. I'll post a short tracker doc with PR links.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync Tue 2027-06-06 16:00 UTC in #incidents.

manu: One more note on recurring pattern: we saw partials align with autoscaler downscale windows. Infra please consider holding scale-in for 2-3 minutes when reconnect flood is detected for canary.

ops-bot: infra note logged. Will coordinate warm-pool hold for canary window.

zoe: Cool — I'll close action items here once PR links and canary results are attached. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
